correctness.rationale: Every one of 4096 subsets is checked by independent connectivity and forbidden-connected-triple predicates. The matching has 402 covers; its complete 809-vertex, 3180-cover directed Hasse graph topologically sorts and leaves precisely 0,3,4 critical counts 1,3,1. The integral signed gradient boundary of the sole 4-cell to all three critical 3-cells is identically zero. The 3-skeleton is a wedge of three S^3 with pi_3=Z^3, so zero attaching degrees imply a nullhomotopic attaching map and an additional S^4. A separate mod-two chain computation independently matches the Betti ranks; the integral claim does not rely on finite-field ranks alone.

value.rationale: This is a complete integral homotopy classification of a canonical well-covered cubic polyhedral graph at the first higher-independence threshold. The coexistence of three 3-spheres with an even-dimensional 4-sphere is structurally noteworthy: the 2020 chordal r=2 theorem only permits sphere dimensions 2j-1. The natural graph and full invariant are motivated independently of computation and yield a non-obvious mixed-dimensional example, not a generic exercise or arbitrary parameter slice.
